name: Maizono Sayaka
source:
Sayaka is the lead singer in a world-famous idol group. She's the darling of a generation, but she's managed to maintain her sweet, down-to-earth nature. At Hope's Peak, she has a surprising reconnection with [url=/c7828]Naegi[/url], who was once her classmate a few years ago. But despite spending several years in the same building, they never actually had any direct contact. Still, she becomes the first student at Hope's Peak that Naegi becomes willing to trust.

[Edited from [url=http://danganronpa.us/danganronpa/characters.html#maizono]official description[/url]]
